ticket.subject: Invoice INV-2026-8095 has the wrong seat count
ticket.body_text:
Hi there!

Writing on behalf of Hollowfen Media. Our September invoice charges for 12 seats although we removed several users last month and now have 8.

The members page in the admin area also shows 8 users. We paid the invoice already so our books stay clean, but we expect a credit for the difference.

Not urgent at all. Please send a corrected invoice or a credit note.

Cheers,
Fatima
